players.product: Indium phosphide (InP) wafers (2-4 inch) for optical-communication lasers and detectors, made by subsidiary Yunnan Xinyao Semiconductor Materials; also gallium arsenide wafers and germanium products (germanium ingots, germanium tetrachloride for optical fiber, solar germanium wafers, infrared optics)

quarterly_data.quarter: Yunnan Germanium results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual (05-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Vice president and board secretary Zhang Xinchang (2025 annual results briefing): the company's InP wafers can be used to make the laser and detector chips in optical modules, but its compound-semiconductor materials (GaAs and InP wafers) were only 12.93% of 2025 revenue and only 14.29% of consolidated gross profit; he cautioned that InP wafer price trends and future supply-demand changes, and so their effect on future results, are highly uncertain.
